components.name: Discovery & Alignment
components.focus: Confirm scope, success metrics, and expectations for Sample Task with COO, Analytics Director.

steps.description: Kickoff with sponsors to confirm the objective — Build baseline dashboard — and success measures.
Document current context, stakeholder map (COO, Analytics Director), and decision cadence.
Finalize problem statement, decision rights, and engagement guardrails.

components.name: Current State & Data Assessment
components.focus: Inventory existing processes, technology, and data needed from HRIS, Project logs, Finance data.

steps.description: Conduct working sessions to map current workflows and tooling.
Audit data availability, quality, and access requirements across HRIS, Project logs, Finance data.
Synthesize findings into opportunity brief and assumptions log.

components.name: Solution Design
components.focus: Translate insights into a future-state design and prioritize deliverables (Requirements doc, dashboard, training).

steps.description: Define user stories, success metrics, and experience flows that deliver Build baseline dashboard.
Draft architecture / operating model options and review with COO, Analytics Director.
Create implementation roadmap with phased milestones and dependencies.

components.name: Build & Iterate
components.focus: Develop prioritized workstreams with Consultant, client analyst, validate with pilot users, and incorporate feedback.

steps.description: Stand up development environment, assign owners, and confirm sprint logistics.
Execute build sprints with weekly showcases and backlog grooming to meet 6 weeks.
Run pilot / UAT sessions and capture iteration requirements.

components.name: Enablement & Change Management
components.focus: Equip stakeholders with training, documentation, and support for adoption.

steps.description: Develop enablement materials and training curriculum.
Facilitate training sessions and gather readiness feedback.
Finalize support model and handoff documentation.

components.name: Measurement & Iteration
components.focus: Define operating rhythms to monitor outcomes, risks (Data quality, stakeholder adoption), and backlog refinements.

steps.description: Launch performance dashboard and baseline key metrics.
Run retrospective to capture lessons learned and enhancement backlog.
Plan next-wave initiatives aligned to strategic objectives.
